aboutP1: Iyi si yerekana amakiliziya Gatolika, shapeli, ingoro z'ubutagatifu, bazilika na katedrali {n}. Biva mu {a1}makuru y'ahantu ya Overture Maps{end} (verisiyo {release}), akusanya ahantu avuye kuri Meta, Microsoft n'izindi nkomoko zifunguye.
aboutP2: Muri ayo, ahantu {cat} handitswe muri Overture nk'ahasengerwa h'Abaromani Gatolika. Ahandi {name} handitswe gusa nk'ahasengerwa h'Abakirisitu, kandi hashyizwemo kubera ko amazina yaho agaragaza neza ko ari Gatolika (urugero “Parroquia”, “Paróquia”, “Basilica”, “Nossa Senhora”). Ibisobanuro byaho bifite icyitonderwa.
aboutP3: Nta makuru afunguye arimo paruwasi zose. Amakuru ni menshi muri Amerika no mu Burayi bw'Iburengerazuba, ni make mu bice bimwe bya Afurika na Aziya, aho paruwasi nyinshi zitaragera ku ikarita. Bimwe bishobora kuba byanditswe kabiri, ari ibiro, cyangwa inyubako zafunzwe. Iyo ufunguye kiliziya, urupapuro rushakisha ifoto yayo kuri {a1}Wikimedia Commons{end} na Wikipedia hakurikijwe aho iri n'izina ryayo, rukavuga n'uwayifashe. Amakiliziya adafite ifoto yerekana igishushanyo. Buri karita ifite amahuza y'andi mafoto, amashusho na Street View.

about_seasonAdvent: Adiventi ni ibyumweru bine bibanziriza Noheli, igihe Kiliziya yitegura ifite ukwizera kwuje ibyishimo ukuza kwa Kristu: yibuka ivuka rye i Betelehemu kandi itegereje kugaruka kwe mu ikuzo. Ibara ryayo ni isine, n'iroza ku Cyumweru cya Gaudete.
about_seasonChristmas: Igihe cya Noheli cyizihiza ivuka ry'Umwami wacu Yezu Kristu, kuva kuri Noheli, unyuze ku Ukwigaragaza kwa Nyagasani, kugeza kuri Batisimu ya Nyagasani. Ibara ryacyo ni umweru, ikimenyetso cy'ibyishimo n'ikuzo.
about_seasonOrdinary: Igihe gisanzwe ni igice cy'umwaka kitari Adiventi, Noheli, Igisibo na Pasika. Icyumweru ku kindi Kiliziya inyura mu buzima no mu nyigisho bya Kristu. Ibara ryacyo ni icyatsi, ikimenyetso cy'ukwizera no gukura.
about_seasonLent: Igisibo ni iminsi mirongo ine y'isengesho, gusiba no gufasha abakene kuva ku wa Gatatu w'Ivu kugeza ku wa Kane Mutagatifu, igihe abakristu bagarukira Imana bicuza kandi bitegura kwizihiza Iyobera rya Pasika. Ibara ryacyo ni isine, n'iroza ku Cyumweru cya Laetare.
about_seasonHolyWeek: Icyumweru Gitagatifu gitangira ku Cyumweru cy'Amashami, Kiliziya yibuka uko Umwami wacu yinjiye i Yeruzalemu, kandi kiganisha ku Minsi Itatu Mitagatifu y'Ububabare, Urupfu n'Izuka bye. Icyumweru cy'Amashami ni umutuku; iminsi y'icyumweru ni isine.
about_seasonTriduum: Iminsi Itatu Mitagatifu ya Pasika, kuva kuri Misa y'Isangira rya Nyagasani ku mugoroba wo ku wa Kane Mutagatifu kugeza ku mugoroba w'Icyumweru cya Pasika, ni yo ndunduro y'umwaka wose wa liturujiya: Ububabare, Urupfu n'Izuka bya Nyagasani.
about_seasonEaster: Igihe cya Pasika ni iminsi mirongo itanu kuva ku Cyumweru cya Pasika kugeza kuri Pentekositi, yizihizwa nk'Icyumweru kimwe kinini cy'ibyishimo muri Nyagasani wazutse. Ibara ryacyo ni umweru, n'umutuku kuri Pentekositi.
